comment: Martial-point counter next to the idea icon has no font asset (inventory font=None) so it renders in Arial next to serif labels; use the same serif the global font map picks for the panel.

Left category tabs: the 25x75 vertical CJK label box (ap -11,0) sits on top of the 80x80 icon at x272-352. Move the label to the right of the icon (x358-558, nothing lives there until the list at x560/604) as a wrapping 2-line max label vertically centred on the icon. onTextChange because story.resizer.txt re-applies AutoResize(12,14) on the Buttons subtree.
List header ('Swordsmanship' etc.) sat in a 75x60 box between two rule lines and wrapped to 'Swor/dsma'. Widen to 220 (Line (2) is pushed right to match).
Right rule line of the list header: start 150px further right so it does not run through the widened header text; shorten so it still ends at x1410.
'Level' label ends 3px before the level bar frame; nudge left for breathing room.
'Maximum Spend:' (pref 162) wrapped in a 137x50 box and was clipped; single line, overflow allowed (value is moved right).
'8/8' value box started at x1617 on top of 'Spend:'. Shift right so it follows the label.
'Training' action button: 45px label in a 180x80 box (pref 172) clipped to 'Trainin' with some fonts. Widen to the 250px button art and let best-fit shrink as a fallback.
'Training Requirements:' header was a 93x31 box (3-line wrap, clipped). Use the full 320px width of the ConditionText block.
Stat relation rows (43px pitch, 300x50 boxes): keep one line per row, floor 14px (resizer allowed 12).

MartialItem list entries: Name is 144x35 with horizontal Overflow, so 40-char English book names run into neighbours. Wrap inside a 132px box (items are 120 wide on a 138px pitch, so 144px boxes overlapped by 6px and two long names could touch; 132 leaves a 6px gutter) centred on the 120px item (x -6 + 66 = 60), best-fit 14-19 (14px readability floor), box 70 tall moved up 3px so a 4-line 14px name (longest key: 63 chars) still ends at the viewport bottom (y970).

Selected book name in the Detail panel: 354x66 Truncate box at fs36 clipped 'Meteor Sword Manual' to one line ('Manual' lost). Widen to 500 centred on the back_gradient art (IconBack ends x944, Points icon starts x1540), raise 10px and make it 88 tall so it still ends above 'Level' (y255), and best-fit 20-34 so 3-line names (longest key: 63 chars) fit. onTextChange because story.resizer.txt targets Detail/Name and the game sets the text on every selection.
